evidence.quoted_text:
base.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        require(not base.stat().st_mode & 0o077,
                "private record directory must have mode 0700: " + str(base))
        name = ("run-" + time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ", time.gmtime())
                + "-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:6])
        self.run_dir = base / name
        self.run_dir.mkdir(mode=0o700)
evidence.reason: At the current tip, claim_run_dir creates the record base and run directory with plain mkdir and never syncs the record-base directory entry (or any newly created parent). The later durable_write of recovery-receipt.json syncs the receipt and its run directory, not the base directory that contains the new run directory entry. A crash can therefore lose the run directory, including prior SHA and trigger state, after admission/host state is already recorded. This is an ordinary crash-consistency defect in the existing durable admission path, not a new requirement. Sync the record base after creating the run directory; if the invocation creates the base or its parents, sync those directory entries too, and fail admission if syncing fails.
